subject: Trial success anchors, ops runway & owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda@novihealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial success anchors (see attachments)

Hi Amanda —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed set of measurable success anchors so we can finalize the trial scope and owners:

Summary of ask
- NoviHealth wants to evaluate Redwood for: API-based semantic search + conversational summarization integrated into an internal triage workflow.
- Key constraints: <1s median latency for short queries, predictable cost, and a quality bar for summaries in the triage flow.

Proposed success anchors (initial baseline)
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 350ms for 128-token responses (target measured from our hosted endpoint).
- Throughput: sustained 30 requests/sec for the typical request mix (70% short prompts, 30% long-context summaries).
- Cost: unit cost <= $0.45 per 1k tokens (token accounting includes prompt + completion).
- Quality: automated-match + human-blind evaluation: 80% of summaries rated >= 4/5 on relevance/accuracy across a 200-sample set.
- Reliability: <1% error rate and automatic fallback to smaller model under load.

Proposed trial structure & timeline
- Week 0 (prep): exchange sample workload (you) + we create trial workspace and baseline config (Redwood).
- Week 1: smoke & stability (10k tokens/day, basic guarding).
- Weeks 2-5: evaluation window (run load, collect logs, human eval set).
- Week 6: readout + decision.

Owners & next steps
- NoviHealth: Amanda (POC owner) to deliver representative workload, evaluation rubric and 200-sample blind set by Tue 7/1.
- Redwood: Kimberly — trial workspace, sample configs, and the initial measurement matrix (attached).
- Redwood: Jordan — onboarding and SDK integration support; schedule 60–90m technical runthrough next week (I recommend Tue 6/30 or Wed 7/1).
- Redwood: Marcus — ops/monitoring, load script templates, and cost telemetry hooks.

Attachments included: trial_measurement_matrix.xlsx (measurement definitions + dashboards), sample_workload_1000.jsonl (anonymized sample requests).

Questions for you before we lock the plan:
1) Do the latency/throughput/cost anchors look reasonable given your expectations?
2) Any compliance or data residency constraints we should pre-wire into the trial?

If this looks reasonable I’ll turn this into a short project plan and we’ll lock the kickoff slot.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Amanda Torres <amanda@novihealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, DevOps Team <infra@novihealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 11:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial success anchors (see attachments)

Kimberly —

Really helpful recap, thanks. A few quick notes inline:

> Latency: p95 generation latency <= 350ms
We'd prefer a p95 target closer to 250–300ms for the short prompts, if that's achievable with a smaller model variant or quantized runtime. Can Redwood indicate tradeoffs for hitting 250ms vs 350ms?

> Throughput: sustained 30 requests/sec
Our internal assessment suggests peak triage traffic could hit 50 rps during busy windows. Can we scope the trial to validate up to 50 rps (burst to sustained) or at least show graceful degradation?

> Quality: 80% >= 4/5 on 200-sample set
We can do a 250-sample blind set and will provide domain-specific labels. Also want to clarify the evaluation rubric (precision on key fields + hallucination check).

Compliance: we need logs to stay within us-east region and we use an on-prem identity provider for SSO — no additional data residency beyond that.

Next steps I can commit to:
- Deliver representative dataset + 250-sample eval set by Mon 6/30 EOD.
- Coordinate infra contacts (cc'd infra) for any ingress rules.

Can we push the trial start to Mon 7/7 to allow my team to prep the eval set?

Thanks,
Amanda
Amanda Torres
Senior PM, NoviHealth
amanda@novihealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda@novihealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial success anchors (see attachments)

Amanda — great context, thanks. I updated the anchors and the measurement approach below based on your ask. I also attached a short measurement matrix that maps signals to owners.

Updated anchors & tradeoffs
- Latency: target p95 = 275ms for short prompts (these will use the quantized runtime on the hosted endpoint). Tradeoff note: hitting 275ms reliably will increase infra footprint; we can run a test at both 275ms and 350ms to show delta.
- Throughput: validate sustained 50 rps for the primary short-prompt mix. We'll run burst tests to 70 rps to verify graceful degradation and fallback behavior.
- Cost: measurement will report cost per 1k tokens (prompt+completion). We'll show projected cost for three operating points (conservative/expected/optimized).
- Quality: run 250-sample blind evaluation. Definition: a pass is >=4/5 by two independent reviewers; separately measure hallucination rate (percentage of outputs with unsupported facts). Goal: >=78% pass rate and hallucination <6%. (We can tune the bar if you prefer 80%.)
- Reliability: target <1% client-visible error and automatic fallback to smaller model variant.

Trial timeline (revised)
- Mon 7/7: kickoff (prep complete)
- Mon 7/7 — Fri 7/11: smoke & tuning (run short latency suites)
- Mon 7/14 — Fri 8/8: evaluation window (four weeks + buffer for extra measurement)
- Week of 8/11: readout and ROI/cost projection

Milestones & owners
- Sample data + eval rubric: Amanda (NoviHealth) — due Mon 6/30 (thanks for committing).
- Trial workspace + baseline config: Kimberly (Redwood) — will share credentials and initial dashboards by Tue 7/1.
- Integration / SDK walkthrough: Jordan (Redwood) — schedule Tue 7/8 10:00 PT (proposed).
- Ops & load tests: Marcus (Redwood) — will request a service account from infra to run load through your test ingress.
- Human eval coordination: Amanda + Redwood CS lead (we'll introduce during kickoff).

Security & residency
- We will configure the trial to keep logs in us-east by default and will not export PII. Marcus will follow up with an onboarding checklist for your infra team.

Attachments: revised_trial_measurement_matrix.xlsx (now maps 250-sample eval, monitoring dashboards, and the three cost projection points).

If that all looks good I will: 1) create a short project plan and share by Tue 7/1, and 2) provision the trial workspace once we have the sample dataset.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the eval set — that will let us move fast.

Best,
Kimberly

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Torres <amanda@novihealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial success anchors (see attachments)

Amanda / Kimberly —

All noted. I locked Tue 7/8 10:00 PT for the integration walkthrough (calendar invite sent). Marcus, I'll loop you in on the ticket to get the service account/credentials from infra.

Quick ops note: Marcus will need a list of 3 representative endpoints and expected QPS distribution for the load scripts. Amanda, if you can attach that to the dataset or send a short CSV that would help us accelerate the smoke tests.

Look forward to kickoff.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
